data.displacement_note: displacement_mm is the whole deformation now applied to the section (every step since its linear placement, the landmark warp included); step_displacement_mm, when present, is only the change this application made over the warp it replaced or was applied onto.
data.holds_note: 18 automatic holds were added between the pairs, over the placed atlas: spots that keep their current place, so a pair moves its neighbourhood up to the holds near it and the section between the pairs stays put. They are not pairs and cannot be edited; they are recomputed from the pairs on every application.
